decisions.reason: Operator training draws directly on the firm's established application know-how and training capabilities, so it can interpret feedback cheaply and it reinforces machine sales.
A fourth rotary axis is a natural accessory to the firm's milling machines; the firm's related engineering knowledge lets it refine it easily and it raises the value of the core systems.

Hybrid additive post-processing lies far from the firm's existing knowledge base, which makes early results harder to interpret, but its own R&D and its strategic aim of advancing materials processing and digital workflows justify continuing for now under close review.
The high-speed CNC milling line is core to the firm's expertise, and its in-house R&D and testing capacity let it keep improving the models in a growing industry.
An automatic tool changer builds on the firm's modular engineering and complements its milling machines, so its absorptive capacity for improving it is high.
